{{Quote|He took control during a coup last year. Killed most of the Loyalists in the Jabiimi congress. Fortunately, a few of us escaped.|Orliss Gillmunn|<ref name="Republic 55" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jabiimi]]te [[Spokesbeing]] [[Alto Stratus]]<ref name="HNN 14:7:02" /> led the [[Jabiimi Nationalists]]<ref name="FF 125" /> in a '''political coup'''<ref name="FF 119" /> against the ruling [[Jabiim Congress]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]]. Stratus had his [[Nimbus commando]]s [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] key members of the ruling [[Jabiim Congress]], and then used his influence to ally Jabiim with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="GaW" /> A few of the [[Jabiimi Loyalists]] managed to escape the purge, including [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Orliss Gillmunn]], who had been the only opposition to Stratus until the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived during the [[Battle of Jabiim]].<ref name="Republic 55" />
